name: codex-browser-connector-externalization
title: Codex browser connector externalization
description: Push page and browser execution toward an external connector boundary so chat core consumes canonical ui payloads and connector evidence instead of page-specific internals.
creator: yudi
notes: This workstream freezes the connector payload contract that page workflow and frontend surfaces will consume later. Audit follow-up: the remaining `page_key -> page_session_id` active-session transport seam belongs here and should be removed instead of preserved as a compatibility fallback. Promoted to active after WS2 closeout audit; no compatibility layer should be added for the new SaaS.
